FAQ.heading: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.q1Question: Which areas do you operate in?
FAQ.q1AnswerTemplate: {summary}. Our studio and workshop are located in Pardes Hana-Karkur, next to the cemetery.
FAQ.q2Question: How long does it take to order and install a headstone?
FAQ.q2Answer: On average, about 4 to 8 weeks from design approval to installation at the cemetery, depending on the stone type and the complexity of the inscription. We prioritize orders according to the funeral and unveiling dates required by Jewish tradition.
FAQ.q3Question: Do you also handle approvals with the cemetery?
FAQ.q3Answer: Yes, our team accompanies you with the cemetery administration to coordinate measurements, approve the design, and set the installation date, so you don't have to deal with the bureaucracy during this difficult time.
FAQ.q4Question: Which stone types are recommended for Israel's weather conditions?
FAQ.q4Answer: Granite and quality marble are the common choice thanks to their resistance to heat, moisture, and direct sunlight over decades. We're happy to help choose the most suitable stone type and finish during the consultation meeting.
FAQ.q5Answer: Our warranty covers the stability of the installation and the quality of the stone and inscription over the years. In case of damage from weather, ground subsidence, or natural wear, we offer headstone maintenance and restoration services.
FAQ.q6Question: Can I order an additional inscription or update to an existing headstone?
FAQ.q6Answer: Absolutely. We engrave additional text, update dates, and touch up color on existing headstones, even ones we did not originally install.
FAQ.q7Question: How long does restoring an existing headstone take?
FAQ.q7Answer: Most restoration work, such as cleaning, foundation reinforcement, and inscription restoration, takes between a single work day and a few days depending on the extent of the damage. More details on the restoration services page.

RenovationHero.heading: Restoring and reviving existing headstones
RenovationHero.subtitle: Moisture, moss, subsidence, and fading inscriptions are natural processes over the years. We give the existing headstone professional, sensitive treatment that restores it to a dignified condition.

RenovationProblems.heading: Common issues we handle
RenovationProblems.problem1Desc: Moisture penetration causes staining and a change in the stone's color over time.
RenovationProblems.problem2Desc: Accumulation of moss and deposits that dull the headstone's original appearance.
RenovationProblems.problem3Desc: Foundation movement causing the headstone to tilt or sink into the ground.
RenovationProblems.problem4Desc: Darkening or fading of the lettering color and engraved details.
RenovationProblems.problem5Desc: Weather damage or mechanical impact that created a crack in the stone.

RenovationProcess.heading: Restoration process
RenovationProcess.intro: Every restoration begins with a personal on-site visit and diagnosis, so we can tailor the right treatment to the specific condition of the headstone.
RenovationProcess.step1Desc: A visit to the cemetery to assess the condition of the stone, foundations, and inscription, and determine the scope of work required.
RenovationProcess.step2Desc: Removal of moisture stains, moss, and mineral deposits using professional methods that don't damage the original stone.
RenovationProcess.step3Desc: Foundation repair, leveling the headstone, and sealing cracks where needed.
RenovationProcess.step4Desc: Refreshing the lettering color and applying a protective coating to prevent future damage.
